Moorman (edges 5890-5972) crosses Taft (north edge ~5892, south edge ~5966); a Moorman stub continues south and is cut by the bottom plate edge just below Taft.
Burdett runs east from Ashland (south section of Ashland, labelled AVE. here and ASHLAND further south); west side of Ashland is lots, so a T.
Burdett (labelled AVE. near the crossing, BURDETT further west) ends at the diagonal Woodburn Ave (street-car tracks); east of Woodburn is Wm. Williams' subdivision lots.
Today's Pomona Court = CLAYTON ST. on the plate (east segment between Hackberry and Cleinview); it ends at Cleinview (lots 16/17 on the east side).

Two short stubs cut by the plate edge leave Gilbert's NW side: one labelled ...TA (Buena Vista) running WNW, one labelled WAL... (Walter) running N. Their centrelines meet right at Gilbert's NW edge; three-way junction.
Walter stub (edges ~1185-1242, cut by plate edge) meets curving Gilbert (NW edge ~2222, SE edge ~2327 at this x) from the north; Buena Vista stub joins at the same corner.
Bonaparte stub (edges 8900-8990, label BONA... cut) runs north off the top plate edge; the E-W street (printed AVE.) has its north edge on the plate edge, south edge ~300, sewer centreline ~245.

No parkway on the 1922 plate. The corridor at the expected point is the N section of ASHLAND (edges ~3430-3517) meeting MYRTLE from the north (T; lots south of Myrtle). Taken as later Victory Parkway alignment; the S section of Ashland (job 67_016) is offset ~240 px west.
